nodes.label: sqlite-vec Loadable Module Build Script
nodes.rationale: Builds sqlite-vec 0.1.9 as a loadable extension (vec0) against a vendored SQLite amalgamation, giving Frigate vector search inside its existing SQLite database instead of adding a separate vector store dependency.

edges.source_location: sqlite-amalgamation-3450300.zip moved into vendor/ before make loadable
the vec0 loadable module is loaded at runtime by the statically built pysqlite3 driver; they vendor different amalgamation versions (3450300 vs 3460100)
both flip apt sources to deb-src with the same VERSION_ID==12 branch, then apt-get build-dep an upstream package before compiling a custom module
